# Australian & New Zealand Donors Guide: Help Disabled Women in Kenya G'day! From Sydney to Auckland, Australians and New Zealanders have always punched above their weight when it comes to international aid. Now you can make a massive impact for Mary and her daughter Lydia, two disabled women in Kenya, with your strong AUD/NZD dollar. This guide shows Aussie and Kiwi donors how to safely donate, how tax deductions work for registered charities, and understand exactly how your hard-earned money transforms lives in East Africa. ## 📋 Table of Contents 1. [Why Your AUD/NZD Goes So Far in Kenya](#why-your-aud-nzd-goes-so-far-in-kenya) 2. [Payment Methods for Aussie & Kiwi Donors](#payment-methods-for-aussie-kiwi-donors) 3. [Tax Rules for Aussie & Kiwi Donors](#tax-rules-for-aussie-kiwi-donors) 4. [Mary & Lydia's Story](#mary-lydia-s-story) 5. [How to Verify Legitimacy](#how-to-verify-legitimacy) 6. [FAQs from Australian & NZ Donors](#faqs-from-australian-nz-donors) --- ## 💰 Why Your AUD/NZD Goes So Far in Kenya ### **The Currency Advantage ("Down Under" to East Africa)** Aussie and Kiwi dollars have **extraordinary purchasing power** in Kenya:
| **Your Currency** | **= Kenya Shillings** | **Your Impact** | |-------------------|-----------------------|-----------------| | $100 AUD | 10,450 KES | **5x local buying power** | | $100 NZD | 9,620 KES | **4.5x local buying power** |
**What this means:** - Your $50 AUD in Kenya = $250 AUD worth of goods/services in Australia - Your $100 NZD in Kenya = $450 NZD worth of care in New Zealand **Real Example:** - Wheelchair in Australia: $2,500 AUD - Wheelchair in Kenya: $500 AUD - **Your savings: $2,000 AUD = Help 4 more people!** --- ### **Donation Impact by Currency** #### **🇦🇺 Australia (AUD - Australian Dollars)**

**Why Kiwi donors choose AbleHearts:** - Card or Apple Pay via secure Paystack checkout - Bank transfer available - 100% transparency (every dollar tracked) --- ## 💳 Payment Methods for Aussie & Kiwi Donors ### **Currently Available:** #### 💳 **1. Card or Apple Pay (Visa, Mastercard)** **Secure Paystack checkout** **How to donate:** 1. Visit: able-hearts.org/donate 2. Choose USD (card, international) 3. Pick or enter an amount 4. Pay with your Australian/NZ card or Apple Pay on Paystack's secure checkout 5. Your bank converts AUD/NZD to USD (check forex rate) 6. Add your email for a receipt (optional) **Fees:** - Commonwealth Bank AU: 3% international transaction fee - ANZ: 3% international transaction fee - Westpac: 3% international transaction fee - NAB: No foreign transaction fee (28° Mastercard) - ASB NZ: 2.5% international fee - BNZ NZ: 2% international fee **Tip:** Use 28° Mastercard (AU) or Wise card for **zero** foreign transaction fees. --- #### 🏦 **2. Bank Transfer (Direct Deposit)** **Best for:** Large donations ($500+ AUD/NZD) **How to donate:** 1. Contact: [donations@able-hearts.org](mailto:donations@able-hearts.org) 2. Request bank transfer details (Kenya Equity Bank) 3. Transfer via your bank (SWIFT/international wire) 4. Provide transfer receipt 5. Receive a confirmation of your gift (not a tax receipt) **Fees:** - Australia: $20-$30 AUD wire fee + bank forex markup - New Zealand: $15-$25 NZD wire fee + bank forex markup - Alternative: **Wise (TransferWise)** = lower fees --- #### ₿ **3. Cryptocurrency (Bitcoin, USDT)** **Best for:** Tech-savvy donors, large amounts ($1,000+ AUD/NZD) **How to donate:** 1. Select "Cryptocurrency" on donate page 2. Send Bitcoin or USDT (TRC20) to wallet address 3. Blockchain confirmation in minutes 4. Share the transaction hash with us if you would like a confirmation of your gift **Fees:** 1-2% (much lower than bank wire or credit card) --- ### **Not Available Yet:** POLi, BPAY, Afterpay and AUD/NZD checkout aren't supported. Card checkout runs in USD, and your bank converts from AUD or NZD. --- ## 🧾 Tax Rules for Aussie & Kiwi Donors ### **Where AbleHearts Stands Today** AbleHearts is **not yet a registered charity**. It is not registered with the ACNC, does not have DGR (Deductible Gift Recipient) status in Australia, and is not an approved donee organisation in New Zealand. That means **gifts to AbleHearts are not currently tax-deductible in Australia and do not qualify for a donation tax credit in New Zealand.** We will update this guide once our registration is complete. ### **🇦🇺 Australia: How Deductions Work in General** - Only gifts to organisations with **DGR status** can be claimed as a deduction - You can check any organisation's DGR status on the ABN Lookup website (abr.business.gov.au) - Claims go in the "Gifts or Donations" section of your tax return, with a receipt from the DGR ### **🇳🇿 New Zealand: How Tax Credits Work in General** - Only gifts to **approved donee organisations** qualify for the donation tax credit - The list of approved donee organisations is published by Inland Revenue (IRD) - Claims are made through myIR with receipts from the approved organisation If tax relief matters to your giving, please check an organisation's status before you give and ask a tax professional about your own situation. --- ## 💖 Mary & Lydia's Story #### Lydia's Story
**Can't see the video?** [Watch Lydia's testimonial on Vimeo](https://vimeo.com/1140751420) #### Mary's Story
**Can't see the video?** [Watch Mary's story on Vimeo](https://vimeo.com/1140751723) ### **Why Aussie & Kiwi Donors Connect** Mary and Lydia are disabled women in rural Kenya living on less than $3 USD/day ($4.50 AUD, $5 NZD)—similar to poverty levels that Australians and New Zealanders abolished decades ago. **Where they are today:** - 😢 **No wheelchair:** reaching a clinic is a long, painful journey - 🏥 **Untreated wounds:** they need regular care and medicine - 🏚️ **Leaking roof:** little shelter in the rainy season - 🍽️ **Often 1 meal/day:** food is a daily worry ### **How It Could Work: An Example from Perth to Kenya** > **Please note:** This is an example of how a gift could reach Mary & Lydia. It hasn't happened yet. Mary & Lydia are real, and their needs are real, but no donor has yet funded the items below. Imagine a donor in Perth gives **$500 AUD**. Here is how that gift could reach Mary & Lydia: 1. 💳 **The donor gives** on our [donate page](/donate) by card or Apple Pay (Paystack checkout) 2. 💱 **The money arrives in Kenya** and is used locally, where prices are far lower than in Australia 3. ♿ **A wheelchair could be bought in Kenya** for Mary, with no shipping costs 4. 📸 **The donor could get an account** of how the gift was used, with receipts and photos, on request **Other gifts could add up the same way:** - 🏥 **$50 AUD a month** from a donor in Sydney could cover regular medical care - 🏠 **$400 AUD** from a donor in Melbourne could fix the leaking roof - ♿ **$300 NZD** from a donor in Wellington could fund a second mobility aid - 🍽️ **$100 AUD a month** from a donor in Brisbane could mean three meals a day None of this has happened yet. It is what a gift from anywhere in Australia or New Zealand could do. **Want to make it real?** [Donate securely](/donate) and ask us how your gift was used. --- ### **What Donors Can Expect:** When you donate, you can expect: - 📧 Immediate email receipt for your records - 📸 Photo updates showing how funds were used, and how donations are used on our [Transparency page](/transparency) - 💌 Direct connection with Mary and Lydia via WhatsApp - 🧾 Receipts and an account of your gift, on request - 🎥 Optional video call opportunities with beneficiaries --- ## 🔎 How to Verify Legitimacy ### **Aussie & Kiwi Donors: Verify Before You Give** #### **1. Check Official Registrations** For any charity you are considering, look it up on the ACNC Charity Register (acnc.gov.au) in Australia or the Charities Register (charities.govt.nz) in New Zealand. **In the open:** AbleHearts will not appear on these registers. It is not yet a registered charity anywhere, and we would rather tell you that plainly than claim a status we cannot show. **Interim Verification:** - ✅ Google Search Console: Verified - ✅ Bing Webmaster: Verified - ✅ 19 pages indexed - ✅ SSL secured website (https://) --- #### **2. Verify 100% Donation Policy** - ✅ No CEO salaries (volunteer-run) - ✅ No office rent (online-only) - ✅ No admin overhead (zero!) - ✅ Every dollar → Mary & Lydia directly --- ## ❓ FAQs from Australian & NZ Donors ### **Q: Is my donation tax-deductible in Australia or New Zealand?** **A:** No, not at the moment. AbleHearts is not yet a registered charity and does not have DGR or donee status, so gifts are not currently tax-deductible and do not qualify for a tax credit. We will update this answer once registration is complete. ### **Q: Can I donate in AUD/NZD or do I need to convert?** **A:** Use your AUD or NZD card as normal. Card checkout runs in USD, and your bank converts the amount from AUD or NZD. ### **Q: Are there foreign transaction fees?** **A:** - Credit card: Depends on your bank (0-3%) - 28° Mastercard (AU): **No** foreign transaction fee - Wise: Low fees (0.5-1%) ### **Q: How do I know my money reached Mary & Lydia?** **A:** You'll receive: 1. M-PESA transfer receipt (Kenya mobile money proof) 2. Photo of Mary/Lydia with purchased items 3. Video thank you message (donations $100+ AUD/NZD) 4. Monthly WhatsApp updates ### **Q: Can I set up recurring monthly donations?** **A:** Automatic monthly billing isn't available, but you can give the same amount each month on the [donate page](/donate). Regular gifts help consistently: - $25 AUD/month = ongoing medical support - $50 AUD/month = food + medical care - $100 AUD/month = comprehensive support ### **Q: What if the charity shuts down or is a scam?** **A:** - Credit card: Chargeback protection (60-120 days) - Prevention: We provide full transparency before you donate - Verification: Check our social media, YouTube, donor testimonials ### **Q: Can I donate via Afterpay (pay later)?** **A:** Not at the moment. Afterpay isn't supported. You can give by card or Apple Pay through Paystack, by bank transfer, or with crypto. ### **Q: Do you accept physical donations (clothes, wheelchairs)?** **A:** Currently, no (shipping costs exceed value). **Cash donations are more impactful:** - Shipping wheelchair AU→KE: $500 AUD - Buying wheelchair locally in Kenya: $500 AUD - **Donate cash = Buy 2 wheelchairs instead of shipping 1!** --- ## ✅ Quick Donation Checklist Before donating, verify: - [ ] Website is secure (https://) - [ ] Paystack secure checkout badge visible - [ ] Charity's registration and tax status stated honestly - [ ] Amount shown clearly before you pay (USD for cards) - [ ] Beneficiary names listed (Mary & Lydia) - [ ] Social media accounts active - [ ] Video proof available (YouTube) - [ ] Monthly updates promised - [ ] 100% donation policy stated **If ALL checked → Safe to donate! 🟢** --- ## 🚀 Ready to Make an Impact? ### **Why Aussie & Kiwi Donors Choose AbleHearts:** 1. **Extraordinary Currency Advantage:** - Your $100 AUD = $500 AUD impact in Kenya - Your $100 NZD = $450 NZD impact in Kenya 2. **Zero Overhead:** - 100% of your donation → Mary & Lydia - No admin costs, no CEO salaries 3. **Full Transparency:** - Monthly photo updates - M-PESA receipts - Video calls available - WhatsApp donor group 4. **Fair Dinkum Aussie Values:** - "Give a Fair Go" to those who need it - Mateship across borders - Kiwi Spirit: "Aroha" (compassion) in action --- ## 🌏 Australia/NZ → Kenya: A Bridge of Compassion When you donate from Sydney, Melbourne, Brisbane, Perth, Auckland, or Wellington to help Mary & Lydia in Kenya, you're proving that: - **Distance (13,000 km) doesn't limit generosity** - **Different continents share common humanity** - **Your strong dollar creates stronger futures** - **"Down Under" cares deeply about "Way Up There"** --- ## 📞 Questions?
